embed.title: !track
embed.description: Alerts for wild pokemon spawns. Name one or more pokemon (or `everything`), then add filters to narrow them down. `{{prefix}}tracked` lists your rules.

fields.name: Choosing pokemon
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}track pikachu`
`{{prefix}}track dratini dragonair dragonite iv:90` — several at once
`{{prefix}}track dratini+ iv:90` — a trailing `+` adds its evolutions
`{{prefix}}track everything iv:100` — every 100% spawn
`{{prefix}}track everything dragon iv:90` — every Dragon type (type names are bare words)
`{{prefix}}track everything gen:1 iv:100` — Kanto only

`everything` needs at least one filter, and your server may not allow it.

fields.name: IV, CP, level and stats
fields.value:
`iv:90-100` — IV range (`iv:90` = 90 or more)
`cp:1500-2500` — CP range
`level:30-35` — level range
`atk:15 def:15 sta:15` — individual IVs (ranges work too: `atk:13-15`)
`miniv:`, `maxiv:`, `mincp:`, `maxcp:`, `maxlevel:` also work

These only match pokemon that have been scanned for IVs.

fields.name: Gender, form, costume, size, rarity, time
fields.value:
`male` / `female` / `genderless`
`form:alola` — a form by name, e.g. `{{prefix}}track vulpix form:alola` (`{{prefix}}info vulpix forms` lists them)
`costume:holiday` — a costume by name; `costume:0` means no costume (`{{prefix}}info pikachu costumes`)
`size:xxl` or `size:xxs-xs` — xxs, xs, m, xl, xxl
`rarity:rare` or `rarity:rare-unseen` — common, uncommon, rare, very_rare, ultra_rare, unseen
`t:600` — at least 600 seconds left before it despawns

fields.name: PVP ranks
fields.value:
`great:1-10` / `ultra:1-10` / `little:1-10` — league rank range (`great10` = top 10)
`greatcp:1450` / `ultracp:2400` / `littlecp:480` — minimum CP for that league (the server sets a floor)
`greathigh:5` / `ultrahigh:` / `littlehigh:` — best rank only
`cap:50` — rank at one level cap (must be a cap your server uses)
`mega`, `mega:x`, `mega:y` — rank its mega evolution

Several leagues make one rule each: `{{prefix}}track azumarill great:1-10 ultra:1-10`. Some servers restrict PVP tracking.

fields.name: Where
fields.value:
`d:1000` — within 1000 m of your location (`{{prefix}}location`)
`d:500 location:home` — measure from a saved location instead (`{{prefix}}help location`)
`area:city_centre` — only in these areas instead of your `{{prefix}}area` list (comma-separate several)

With neither `d:` nor `area:`, alerts come from your areas. `area:` can't be combined with `d:` or `location:`.

fields.name: Message options
Remove and mute
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}untrack pikachu` — remove all your pikachu rules (`{{prefix}}track remove pikachu` is the same)
`{{prefix}}untrack id:45` — remove one pokemon rule by the id shown in `{{prefix}}tracked`
`{{prefix}}track mute pikachu duration:2h` — pause pikachu alerts without deleting rules
`{{prefix}}track mute id:45` — pause one rule (`{{prefix}}help mute`)
